title: Release quest-cli 0.15.1 (patch after the 0.15.0 pair)
description: Carrier for the patch release after the 0.15.0 quest/lore pair. First item: QCLI-571 (the wrapper lifeline). DEC-282 (a4) item 2, opum-doc ODOC-610 note: DECIDED. Due rule: pair publish (LCLI-775 step F, the operator) + 7 days. The date is relative to the real pair publish and becomes absolute the day the pair publishes; the earlier proposed cap of 2026-11-27 is dropped (an absolute cap can fall before the pair ships). If the pair publish slips, its own record carries the date, not this carrier.
